title: Async functions and suspension points
summary: Declare an async function and await its result. Task.yield illustrates cooperative suspension without blocking a thread.
triggers: a function depends on a result produced asynchronously
prompts: Compose a greeting from an asynchronously loaded member name.
invariant: The greeting is constructed only after the name becomes available.
mantra: Mark async work; await its dependency; continue with the value.
pitfalls: await marks a possible suspension, not a guarantee of a thread switch.
Task.yield is a cooperative scheduling hint, not a delay or network request.
